info.title: Sailor Moon SuperS
info.synopsis: Nella quarta serie di Sailor Moon i nuovi avversari delle guerriere sono gli artisti circensi del Dead Moon Circus, capeggiati dall’algida e bellissima regina Nehellenia, la quale, volendo liberarsi di un maleficio che la tiene costantemente imprigionata in uno specchio, mira a catturare un mistico unicorno alato chiamato Pegasus, il cui corno d’oro le garantirebbe poteri illimitati. Pegasus è il leggendario guardiano dei sogni dei bambini, ed è nel più puro di essi, simboleggiato da un brillante specchio dorato, che si nasconde. Compito delle guerriere, stavolta, sarà di trovarlo e proteggerlo.

episodes.title: Meeting of Destiny: The Night Pegasus Dances
episodes.synopsis:
Chibiusa is in a trance, and is lead to follow a young male voice...suddenly winding up in a crystal forest. Chibiusa meets a white unicorn named Pegasus, and they talk. Usagi wakes her up, and they go out on the town, to hang with Mamoru, Motoki, and Motoki's sister Unazuki. Usagi tries to spook Chibiusa about eclipses, when suddenly a tent appears in the area after the eclipse has taken place. In the tent, we see Madame Zirconia ruling over her Amazon Trio, Hawk Eye, FIsh Eye and Tiger Eye, and they discuss the dream mirrors. Naturally, the target is Unazuki. On a bus, Tigers Eye attacks Unazuki, and the
s hear her shrills and run to her aid. Karakuriko is the lemure used, so Sailor Moon and Sailor Chibimoon fight her off, and save Unazuki's dreams.

episodes.title: Super Transformation Once Again: Pegasus`s Power
episodes.synopsis: Thanks to the mysterious pegasus, Usagi gains the power of Super Sailor Moon.

episodes.title: Protect Mom`s Dream: Double Moon`s New Attack
episodes.synopsis: Usagi has a fight with Chibiusa, Shingo and Ikuko over lemon pie (very Usagi like) and despite Ami and Rei's attempts to calm her, she stays angry. Hawkseye takes his turn, and goes after his new target, Ikuko! Ikuko is with Chibiusa when she is attacked, so Chibiusa fetches Usagi's help. They transform, and try to fight Hawkseye, and his lemure, off but no dice. Pegasus grants Sailor Moon a new attack ""Moon Gorgeous Meditation"", which works like a charm...and Ikuko's dream is saved.

episodes.title: Catch Pegasus: The Amazon`s Trap
episodes.synopsis: Usagi and the girls try to help Naru and Umino, when Naru becomes the target of Tigers Eye. She gets trapped into Tigers Eye's cage, but Pegasus helps save her, and her dream is saved. Sailor Moon and the soliders use their attacks, and are able to defeat the lemures.

episodes.title: The Perfect Couple: Usagi and Mamoru`s Love
episodes.synopsis: Chibiusa worries that Saori, a friend of Mamoru's from college, is romantically interested in him.

episodes.title: Artemis Is Cheating? Enter the Mysterious Kitten
episodes.synopsis: When a cat from the future appears to the past, Luna thinks Artemis cheated on her and had a kitten.

episodes.title: Makoto`s Friendship: The Girl Who Admired Pegasus
episodes.synopsis: Usagi and Chibiusa are excited to discover that a best-selling book was written by an old friend of Makoto's.

episodes.title: Connecting Hearts: Chibi-Usa and Pegasus
episodes.synopsis: Tiger's Eye targets Chibiusa's art teacher in the hopes of attacking Pegasus and finding his host.

episodes.title: Protect Mamoru: Ninja Usagi`s Jealousy
episodes.synopsis: Mamoru moves into the Hikawa Shrine after his apartment is wrecked, so Usagi assumes the guise of a ninja to protect his honor.

episodes.title: Forest of Illusion: A Beautiful Fairy`s Invitation
episodes.synopsis: Chibi-Usa befriends a young man, an artist fixated on the existence of fairies, who is targeted by Fish-eye.

episodes.title: Drive to the Heavens: The Dream Car Fueled with Love
episodes.synopsis: Ami befriends Mamoru's colleague Natsumi, a widow who is trying to restore a classic car.

episodes.title: Aim for No. 1 in Japan: The Troubles of a Pretty Swordswoman
episodes.synopsis: A young ignored warrior girl attempts to pursue her dream as the strongest warrior in Japan, that is until Tigers Eye attempts to destroy her dream mirror.

episodes.title: We Love Fashion: The Stylish Guardians
episodes.synopsis: Fisheye targets the fashion designer Yoshiki Usui, while Usagi hopes to persuade the designer to make her a wedding dress for free.

episodes.title: Storm of Love: Minako`s Grand Two-Timing Plan
episodes.synopsis: Trouble stirs up when both Tigers Eye and Hawks Eye go after the same dream mirror, Minako's.

episodes.title: The Secret Mansion: A Menu of Love for You
episodes.synopsis: The girls become interested in an apparently antisocial old woman after she takes Diana into her home.

episodes.title: Believe in Pegasus: The Four Guardians` Super Transformation
episodes.synopsis: Reports begin to flood in of a Pegasus wreaking havoc in the city. Meanwhile, a popular boy shows an interest in Chibiusa.

episodes.title: Shining Summer Days: Ami Under the Sea-Breeze
episodes.synopsis: Shingo develops a crush on Ami during a trip to the beach, while Tiger's Eye plot to seduce her.

episodes.title: Become a Prima: Usagi`s Ballet
episodes.synopsis: It's a battle for best ballerina! Who can win? The stunning, beautiful but natural clumsy Usagi or the villionous Fish Eye?

episodes.title: Juban Holiday: The Carefree Princess
episodes.synopsis: Usagi and Chibiusa are befriended by a mysterious foreign woman who accompanies them to the Azabu-Juuban summer festival. Unbeknownst to them, their acquaintance is a visiting princess who is being pursed by both her government and Hawk's Eye.

episodes.title: Destined Partners? Makoto`s Innocence
episodes.synopsis: Tiger's Eye plans to seduce the girls at a university dance party, while Makoto is immediately smitten with the charming stranger.

episodes.title: Shadow of Evil: The Trio`s Last Chance
episodes.synopsis: Zirconia gives Fish Eye the photo of a man to attack, and Fish Eye goes after the target. The target is Mamoru.

episodes.title: Mirrors of Dreams: The Amazon`s Last Stage
episodes.synopsis: Fish Eye is devasted to learn that he will not get to be a human with beautiful dreams anymore after the next full moon. He poses as a female, and wants to be with Mamoru before he gets transported back to a fish. Mamoru is to loyal to Usagi to accept. Fish Eye still wins a kiss. Fish Eye is depressed about not getting his love, and winds up going to Usagi's house to seek shelter from the rain. He is shocked to find out, Usagi is Super Sailor Moon and best of all, Pegasus is in Chibiusa's care. Zirconia is ready to replace the Amazon Trio with the Amazon Quartet, and they send out a demon to berid of Tigers Eye, Hawks Eye and Fish Eye. The remaining 2/3's of the trio come down to Earth, and there they attack Usagi for her mirror. Fish Eye explains his wish of having dreams, and everyone agrees they want to be full human. The Quartet's demon attacks Fish Eye, but Hawks Eye saves him by stepping in the way, and is killed. With the power of Pegasus, the demon is killed but the full moon s

episodes.title: The Amazoness: Nightmare from Behind the Mirrors
episodes.synopsis: Zirconia sends the Amazoness Quartet in search of the Golden Mirror, and their first target is Chibiusa's friend Momoko.

episodes.title: True Power Explodes: Ami`s Melody of the Heart
episodes.synopsis: Ami becomes obsessed with a tune she found on the internet, and writes lyrics to it. Meanwhile, VesVes of the Amazoness Quartet targets the tune's composer.

episodes.title: Flames of Passion: Mars`s Raging Super Attack
episodes.synopsis: Usagi sees Rei on a cover of a popular magazine and sees that at the shrine she is overly popular. A little girl decides to dress up like Rei and help her. This girl idolizes Rei! Rei tells the other girls that she is annoyed by her, and she is sad and runs away. One of the Amazon Quartet girls takes her dream. Moon and team defeat the youma.

episodes.title: Dentist of Horrors? Palla-Palla`s House
episodes.synopsis: Para-para is sent on a job to open a dentist job in order to steal dreams. Usagi and Chibiusa, along with many people, have cavities and go to that dentist. Mamo notices that many people come into the dentist place, but no one comes out. Usagi and Chibiusa are attacked and Mamo as Tuxedo Kamen goes to save them. Para-para is sad to know it has all failed. Ikuko sends the two girls to the Juuban Dentist because theit cavities are real!

episodes.title: Clash of Dreams: Minako and Makoto`s Broken Friendship
episodes.synopsis: Makoto and Minako both fall for an attractive kindergarten teacher, but Minako's all-out attempts to ingratiate herself with him soon annoyed to Makoto.

episodes.title: Overcome Your Fear: The Jump to Freedom
episodes.synopsis: On the eve of his school's athletic meet, Kyuusuke worries about the box horse, the one obstacle he is unable to clear. JunJun approaches him with the intention of taking his Dream Mirror, and offers to be his coach.

episodes.title: Don`t Lose Sight of Your Dreams: The Mirror of Truth
episodes.synopsis: Usagi and Chibiusa befriend Kamoi, a starving young artist, who is later targeted by CereCere.

episodes.title: Pegasus Disappears: Wavering Friendship
episodes.synopsis: While VesVes targets an eccentric acquaintance of Chibiusa's who is trying to make a flying machine, Chibiusa worries that Pegasus does not trust her.

episodes.title: Pegasus`s Secret: The Boy Who Protects the Dream World
episodes.synopsis: PallaPalla's magic causes Usagi and Chibiusa to switch ages, turning Usagi into a child and Chibiusa into a teenager. While Chibiusa is thrilled with her new body, she is distressed to discover that she can no longer call Pegasus.

episodes.title: Chibi-Usa`s Little Rhapsody of Love
episodes.synopsis: As Chibiusa becomes even more enamoured of Helios, Usagi and her friends realise that she is in love, and are determined to discover the identity of her crush.

episodes.title: Dream to Be an Adult: The Amazoness` Confusion
episodes.synopsis: Usagi and her friends, along with the Amazoness Quartet, assist in the organization of a coming-of-age ceremony.

episodes.title: Terror in Motion: The Dark Queen`s Evil Hand
episodes.synopsis: Intent on escaping her mirror, Queen Nehellenia causes spider webs to appear all over the city, casting it into darkness.

episodes.title: The Source of Darkness: Dead Moon Circus
episodes.synopsis: The Sailor Team infiltrate the Dead Moon Circus and are confronted by Zirconia.

episodes.title: Labyrinth of Mirrors: Chibi Moon Captured
episodes.synopsis: After being captured by Queen Nehellenia, Sailor Chibi Moon confronts the evil queen.

episodes.title: The Golden Crystal Appears: Nehelenia`s Magic
episodes.synopsis: Queen Nehellenia forces Helios to return to his body and give up the Golden Crystal, allowing the evil queen to break free from her mirror.

episodes.title: When the Crystal Shines: The Beautiful Power of Dreams
episodes.synopsis: Queen Nehellenia, free from her mirror at last, prepares to use the power of the Golden Crystal.

episodes.title: Dreams Forever: Fill the Heavens with Light
episodes.synopsis: Queen Nehellenia makes a desperate last stand as the Golden Crystal destroys the Dead Moon Circus.

info.title: Dealing with Mikadono Sisters Is a Breeze
info.synopsis: Sebbene Yu Ayase sia il figlio di un'attrice famosa e talentuosa, si rivela un ragazzo sotto la media in tutto quello che fa. L'unica cosa che sembra aver ereditato dalla propria madre è il suo bel aspetto. Quando Yu si iscrive alle superiori finisce per essere affidato a un'amica della madre e si trasferisce a casa della famiglia Mikadono. Qui farà conoscenza delle tre sorelle dotate di bellezza e talento, che frequentano la sua stessa scuola. Il ragazzo inizia a pensare che sia impossibile raggiungere un rapporto tra una persona normale e delle persone con talento, però le sorelle inizieranno a sorprenderlo con il loro carattere inaspettato...

episodes.title: Prodigy and Mediocrity
episodes.synopsis: Yu Ayase transfers to a school for prodigies—but despite his gifted mother, he's perfectly mediocre.

episodes.title: Her Secret
episodes.synopsis: Tasked with looking out for the sisters, Yu tries to win them over—through their stomachs.

episodes.title: I Want Us to Be a Family
episodes.synopsis: Yu begins to get to know the three sisters, and they start to see him as more than just an unwelcome guest.

episodes.title: A Memory the Sisters Can Share
episodes.synopsis: Yu carries out his plan to have the sisters enjoy the Cherry Blossom Night Festival together.

episodes.title: A Father`s Teachings
episodes.synopsis: The three sisters grow closer after the festival... and then their father comes home.

episodes.title: This Is a Date
episodes.synopsis: As Kazuki prepares for her most challenging role yet, she asks Yu on a date to get in the mindset.

episodes.title: The True Reason Is...
episodes.synopsis: Hayato Tatsumi, the ace and captain of the Iwayama High School karate team, appears before Yu and the sisters.

episodes.title: You Will Win No Matter What
episodes.synopsis: Yu throws himself into intense training with Niko's help, preparing for his one-on-one showdown with Hayato.

episodes.title: I`ll Make You Swoon
episodes.synopsis: Niko wins the battle against Hayato, so she says to Yu “I’ll grant you any wish” for doing his best for her.

episodes.title: The Shadow of a Genius
episodes.synopsis: Yu delivers Miwa's forgotten lunch during her shogi game. Touched, she asks him to have lunch with her.

episodes.title: I Already Knew It
episodes.synopsis: Kazuki and Niko try to console Miwa, but she gets angry and runs out of the house. Yu goes to look for her.

episodes.title: For Someone Else
episodes.synopsis: Miwa faces off against Sakura now imbued with focus and determination.

info.title: Wind Breaker (ITA)
info.synopsis: La Fuurin è una scuola nota per avere gli studenti con i peggiori rendimenti scolastici e i combattenti più forti in circolazione. Volendo diventare il più forte di tutti e venire considerato alla stregua di un eroe, Sakura Haruka si unisce a un gruppo nato per proteggere la città.

episodes.title: Sakura Arrives at Furin
episodes.synopsis: An admirer of strong people with a complete disinterest in the weak, Haruka Sakura, a loner and delinquent high school student, aims to be a fighter at the top of Furin High School. Coming from outside the city, Sakura enrolls in Furin High School, infamous for its delinquents.

episodes.title: The Hero of My Dreams
episodes.synopsis: It is the morning of the school entrance ceremony, and Furin High School has transformed into a group that protects the town now known as the "Chime of the Wind Breaker" — Bofurin.

episodes.title: The Man Who Stands at the Top
episodes.synopsis:
Furin High School's first-year Class 1 is infamous for its group of strong fighters.
One of the students in the class, Kyotaro Sugishita, becomes furious with what Sakura said and throws a punch at him. The two begin a spectacular fight, ignoring an aloof Hayato Suo, who's carefully watching the fight, and Nirei, who's now panicking.

A tremendously loud voice echoes throughout the school, interrupting the fight between the two young men. The owner of that voice that instantly changed the mood of the entire school is none other than Umemiya, the Representative of Bofurin. Sakura and the rest look nervously up at the speakers to hear Umemiya say something completely unexpected.

episodes.title: Clash
episodes.synopsis: A fight breaks out between Bofurin and Shishitoren as Bofurin tries to protect the town's middle schoolers. Sakura receives a declaration of war from the group's second-in-command, Jo Togame. Sakura and one of the Four Kings of Bofurin, Toma Hiragi, tell Umemiya what happened.

episodes.title: A Gentleman
episodes.synopsis: "That’s why I'm going to take all of Furin…and you for myself!" declares Shishitoren's leader, Choji Tomiyama, as he makes his way onto Furin High School grounds. Finally, it's a one-on-one showdown between Bofurin and Shishitoren!

episodes.title: Vow to Follow
episodes.synopsis: Tomiyama and Togame, far from worrying about their teammate who lost the battle, expel him from their team. While this peculiar spectacle shakes Sakura and the rest, Suo becomes unexpectedly emotional and wins against Minoru Kanuma, earning another win for Bofurin.

episodes.title: Fight to Win
episodes.synopsis: It’s now time for the battle of those second-in-command: Sakura versus Togame — a fight that will set things on fire!

episodes.title: Succeeding the Past
episodes.synopsis: Togame can no longer hide the fact he's feeling lost. He remembers when he met Tomiyama, the fun days he had with Shishitoren, how the team changed when Tomiyama became the leader, and the things he's done himself.

episodes.title: Umemiya`s Style
episodes.synopsis: It's now time for a one-on-one fight between Umemiya and Tomiyama. Tomiyama believed that by winning against Umemiya, he would obtain Furin High School, freedom, and a sense of fun that would rival no other.

episodes.title: Dialogue
episodes.synopsis: Admitting defeat, Tomiyama tries to pass Shishitoren on to Umemiya — to which Umemiya declares, "Instead of taking over your team, we'll be friends!" Bofurin and Shishitoren are dumbfounded at this turn of events but talks progress, food is brought, and a celebratory afterparty starts.

episodes.title: New Classmates
episodes.synopsis: With the fights against Shishitoren over, Class 1 enthusiastically welcomes Sakura, Nirei, and Suo's return. Their classmates, brimming with interest in the details of the fights, surround them, asking questions. Sakura can't hide his bashfulness.

episodes.title: The Dependable One
episodes.synopsis: Ren Kaji, Yuto Kusumi, and Takeshi Enomoto, second-year students from the Tamon Team, start their ruling on who will be Grade Captain for first-year Class 1. Suo is the first to raise his hand, immediately nominating Sakura as the other classmates vote for him one after the other.

episodes.title: For a Friend
episodes.synopsis: Sakura, Nirei, and Suo finish their meeting with Umemiya, the other members of the Four Kings, and other prominent leading figures and join up with Kiryu and Tsugeura on their way home.

info.title: Dan Doh!!
info.synopsis: Protagonista di questo anime è un ragazzo molto abile nel baseball, che sfidato dal preside della scuola a colpire la palla appoggiata al suolo. Rimane stupito dalla difficoltà dell’azione. Gli vengono così spiegati i rudimenti del golf che da quel giorno diventerà per lui un chiodo fisso. Dopo le difficoltà iniziali si dimostrerà molto dotato tanto da mettere difficoltà gente con molta più esperienza di lui. Tra le altre cose vedrà nel golf un modo per guadagnare un bel po’ e poter così rivedere sua madre…

info.title: Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle
info.synopsis: Saku Chitose della sezione 5 è uno studente molto popolare. Nonostante venga insultato online dai ragazzi della sua scuola, è sempre circondato da amici. Yuuko Hiragi, la potenziale fidanzata, con l'aura da principessa; Yua Uchida, la ragazza che dà sempre il massimo ed è popolarissima; Haru Aomi, la stella del club di basket, piena di energie, sono solo alcune delle ragazze che gli ruotano attorno. Ma il tempo per divertirsi al massimo con tutte loro potrebbe finire quando un professore affida a Chitose il compito di riportare a scuola un certo hikikomori...

episodes.synopsis: Saku Chitose is an elite student who has an unexpected wrench thrown into his beautiful life.

episodes.synopsis: Chitose tries to break down Kenta's barrier and will help him change if he returns to class.

episodes.title: A Lonesome Hero

episodes.title: The Marble Moon in the Ramune Bottle

episodes.title: A Fickle Starting Line
episodes.synopsis: Nanase Yuzuki needs a boyfriend, and it has to be Saku Chitose. But why?

episodes.title: Blue Basketball Shoes
episodes.synopsis: The situation surrounding Yuzuki grows more serious.

episodes.title: Ups and Downs
episodes.synopsis: Yuzuki has won the bet with Saku, and it’s time to cash in.

episodes.title: How to End the Unending Rain
episodes.synopsis: The frustrations start to get to Yuzuki and Saku.

episodes.title: A Relationship with a Name and a Rift Without One
episodes.synopsis: Saku and Yuzuki share moments from their past that make them reflect.

episodes.title: A Distant Moon
episodes.synopsis: The situation with Yuzuki and Yanashita comes to a head.

episodes.title: Rainy with a Chance Of...
episodes.synopsis: As the rainy season hangs oppressively over Fukui, a meeting over future plans brightens the day.

episodes.title: With a Chance of Dreams
episodes.synopsis: A cloud now hangs above Saku as he learns Asuka may leave to go to Tokyo.

episodes.title: The Left-Ear Promise
episodes.synopsis: Asuka decides to fight for her dream, and Saku's right there with her! Is that a good thing or bad?

info.title: Scum of the Brave
info.synopsis: In un ventunesimo secolo alternativo, i ricchi membri della mafia possono trasformarsi in cavalieri demoniaci grazie a un intervento chirurgico di potenziamento. Al cacciatore di taglie Yashiro viene offerto di prendersi cura di tre giovani apprendisti. Egli accetta bramando il compenso, ma forse questo non sarà abbastanza per ripagarlo del suo nuovo destino.

episodes.title: Meeting of the Braves
episodes.synopsis: In a world where crime has turned fantastical, Braves like Yashiro to take down the magical criminals.

episodes.title: A Brave`s Magic
episodes.synopsis: Jogamine and Yashiro make a move on the Count of Amber Thorns' base.

episodes.title: A Teacher for Braves
episodes.synopsis: Yashiro is adamant about not teaching the girls, but Indo is determined to get stronger with his help.

episodes.title: A Brave`s Errands
episodes.synopsis: Yashiro finds himself reluctantly paired with Jogamine on an errand for Ishino.

episodes.title: A Brave Sensei
episodes.synopsis: Sara comes to Yashiro needing supervision for an assignment from the academy.

episodes.title: A Brave`s Special Training
episodes.synopsis: Yashiro finds himself in need of quick cash, leading to some fighting lessons with the girls.

episodes.title: Death of a Brave
episodes.synopsis: Yashiro's training for the girls runs into trouble when mysterious assailants attack them.

episodes.title: A Brave`s Sins
episodes.synopsis: With one of his cohorts dead, Yashiro is out for revenge.

episodes.title: A Brave`s Legacy
episodes.synopsis: The quest to track down Ishino's killers leads Yashiro to a party being thrown by his long-time nemesis.

episodes.title: A Brave`s Instruction
episodes.synopsis: Yashiro's confrontation with the Coffin Count of Storms is cut short when the Half Dragon sends assailants.

episodes.title: A Brave`s Teamwork
episodes.synopsis: As Jogamine drives Yashiro crazy with her refusal to listen to his tactics, he comes to a realization.

episodes.title: A Brave`s Secret
episodes.synopsis: The confrontation at the party comes to a close, with Jogamine now at the center of another mystery.

episodes.title: A Brave`s Doubts
episodes.synopsis: Yashiro and the girls head to Hokkaido to try and track down facts about the Half Dragon.

episodes.title: A Brave Priest
episodes.synopsis: Yashiro and his apprentices enlist in a mission to execute a raid on a Half Dragon ally.

episodes.title: A Brave`s Melee
episodes.synopsis: Yashiro and Malta search for info on the Half Dragon inside the Count of the Venusian Veil's fortress.

episodes.title: The Darkness of Braves
episodes.synopsis: Yashiro and the girls square off a Half Dragon ally, in hopes of learning more about the enemy.

episodes.title: Return of the Braves
episodes.synopsis: Burdened with new information from the mission to Hokkaido, Yashiro returns to find Tokyo a warzone.

episodes.title: Braves in Danger
episodes.synopsis: Pursued by Half Dargon forces, Yashiro and the girls try to escape in a stolen van.

episodes.title: A Brave`s Motivation
episodes.synopsis: Forced onto foot and with Indo missing, Yashiro, Jogamine, and Sara begin the march to Ed's bar.

episodes.title: A Brave`s Rescue
episodes.synopsis: Yashiro falls into the clutches of the Coffin Count of Storms, but his friends aren't far behind.

episodes.title: A Brave`s Pride
episodes.synopsis: When the members of Half Dragon shows up to interrupt Yashiro's rescue, it turns into a 4-on-4 battle.

episodes.title: A Brave`s Ideal
episodes.synopsis: As they pursue the Coffin Count of Storms, Yashiro battles Levi while Jogamine fights Tomoe.

episodes.title: A Brave`s Truth
episodes.synopsis: The battle against the Coffin Count of Storms continues as Yashiro attempts to uncover her secret.

episodes.title: A Brave`s Lie
episodes.synopsis: Forced to confront the truth, how will Yashiro react?

info.title: Giant Gorg
info.synopsis: Il giovane Yū Tagami si reca sull'Isola Australe, emersa dal mare dieci anni prima (ma senza essere segnata nelle cartine geografiche), cercando di indagare sulla morte del padre, un professore che stava studiando questa nuova terra inesplorata e che è rimasto ucciso in circostanze misteriose. Nell'effettuare le sue ricerche Yū scoprirà che nell'isola si trovano manufatti misteriosi, mostri meccanici, alieni e robot giganti. Il giovane suo malgrado si troverà in una situazione più grande di lui e dovrà combattere contro un'organizzazione criminale nota come GAIL.

episodes.title: Again, Towards the Mountain of Fire

info.title: The Warrior Princess and the Barbaric King
info.synopsis: Durante una feroce battaglia la guerriera più forte dell'intero occidente, Seraphina de Lavillant viene catturata e resa prigioniera dai barbari orientali. Convinta di doversi sottoporre a infinte torture prega di venire uccisa, ma le viene offerto un matrimonio con il re del loro popolo.

episodes.title: The Defeated Warrior Princess, Taken Captive
episodes.synopsis: Serafina, a knight from the Illdoren Kingdom fighting in an eastern expedition, meets her match.

episodes.title: Fear of the Unknown
episodes.synopsis: Veor shows Serafina a small part of his life, leading to no small bit of culture shock.

episodes.title: To Be a Warrior Is to Be a Hypocrite
episodes.synopsis: Veor intends on introducing Sera to more of the tribe, but the cultural exchange is suddenly interrupted.

episodes.title: A Drinking Party Clears the Fog
episodes.synopsis: Sera is introduced to the chiefs of the other tribes, who are not what she expected.

episodes.title: Hands That Pray for Coming Conflict
episodes.synopsis: A party headed by a retinue priest from the eastern expedition shows up, looking to "rescue" Sera.

episodes.title: Man-Made Disasters
episodes.synopsis: Sera works with Veor and the barbarians to overcome the Fiend, before having an unexpected reunion.

episodes.title: Flows to Purify Corruption
episodes.synopsis: Sera and Malcius witness the ritual to undo the damage caused by the Fiend.

episodes.title: A Contract in the Form of a Collaring
episodes.synopsis: After her engagement necklace comes off, Sera tries to find a way to put back on.

episodes.title: Visions Upon the Scales of the Soul
episodes.synopsis: With Sera feeling conflicted, Veor offers a suggestion to help her gain perspective.

episodes.title: Steam Veils the Foothills
episodes.synopsis: Sera and her group arrive at the Quefto city of Furnace Ridge.

episodes.title: Discovery is the Mother of All Quefto
episodes.synopsis: Sera learns the incredible inspiration behind the Quefto's curiosity.

episodes.title: The Crimson Warrior of Glory
episodes.synopsis: Sera and Veor, with a cohort of Quefto, do battle against the fearsome Guren Nairi!

info.title: Muteking (ITA)
info.synopsis: Il protagonista della storia è Linn, un ragazzino americano di dodici anni che, nei panni dell'eroe Muteking, collabora con Takoro. Quest'ultimo è una sorta di polipo rosa alieno che si trova a San Francisco per catturare la famigerata banda della piovra, formato appunto da 4 piovre provenienti dal suo pianeta natale.

episodes.title: La pigrizia è una brutta cosa

info.title: Mobile Suit Gundam Hathaway: The Sorcery of Nymph Circe
info.synopsis: Secondo film della trilogia di Hathaway che celebra il 40° anniversario del franchise di Gundam, e il secondo progetto nel "UC NexT 0100 Project" che affronterà il futuro della timeline dell'UC.

info.title: Paw & Palaces
info.synopsis: All'insaputa dei turisti che affollano la Città Proibita, sei gatti speciali compongono la "Guardia Imperiale dei Gatti", un'organizzazione segreta creata per proteggere i tesori nazionali. Di notte, la squadra entra nel Wuhua, la dimensione spirituale custodita nei reperti d'epoca, per difenderne le memorie storiche dalla malvagia entità demoniaca Black Owl. Tra scontri per ripristinare il corretto corso del passato, litigi e momenti di unione, i felini lottano per salvaguardare il patrimonio culturale dell'umanità.
